caption: The drawing depicts a pair of sandals placed one on top of the other, with both sandals facing to the right side of the composition. The sandals have flat soles and simple uppers, with a strap that crosses over the foot and is attached by a visible rivet or button near the base. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance typical of graphite or charcoal. The sandals are carefully shaded, with attention to the contours and folds of the material, and they cast a subtle, soft shadow on the plain, lightly textured background. The outlines of the sandals are crisp, and the artist’s signature, including the name "Edward Loper" and the date “Dec. 7–39,” is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Pattens
